delete.description: Individual account deletion per spec/behavior/data-retention.md: profile media is purged first, PII is scrubbed to a "Deleted User" tombstone, historical records stay preserved anonymized, the analytics forget is confirmed, and the Supabase Auth account is deleted last. A 502 means the flow did not finish — depending on the failing step the account may already be anonymized (sign-in still works until the final step succeeds) — and every step is idempotent, so simply retry until it returns success.

permissions.description: Caller's effective permission set for the active chapter. Contains the wildcard `*` for Presidents. Empty array means no active roles.

filename.description: Original filename for the avatar image

distinct_id.description: Pseudonymous analytics id (HMAC of the user id), or null when analytics is unconfigured.

enabled.description: Whether analytics is enabled for this caller.

name.description: Behavioral event name in kebab-case, e.g. "opened-channel", "ran-slash-command". Must describe behavior, never content.

chapter_id.description: Chapter the event is attributed to (enables the opt-out gate)

properties.description: Behavioral, content-free properties. Values must be scalars (string/number/boolean/null); keys that look like content/PII (content, body, email, name, …) are rejected.

org_archetype.description: Org archetype key (ifc, npc, nphc, mgc, …). Defaults to ifc.

directory_id.description: chapter_directory row id when the chapter was matched

accept_terms_privacy.description: The admin accepted the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Must be true (spec/behavior/legal.md). The acceptance timestamp and policy version are recorded server-side from the session — never from this payload.

key.description: Workflow key from the chapter catalog

analytics_opt_out.description: When true, disables pseudonymous product analytics for this chapter (data-retention.md #analytics-events-pseudonymous).

custom_fields.description: Custom-field values, present only on single-member reads and already filtered to the fields the requesting viewer may see.

custom_role_ids.description: Assigned chapter_custom_roles ids. Omit to leave custom-role assignment unchanged; an empty array clears it.

role.description: Role name to assign to invited member

is_enabled.description: Whether notifications for this category are enabled

quiet_hours_start.description: Quiet hours start (HH:mm format, e.g. 22:00). Pass null to clear.

quiet_hours_end.description: Quiet hours end (HH:mm format, e.g. 08:00). Pass null to clear.

channel_id.description: When set with `client_message_id`, posts an interactive event card to this chat channel after the event is created (the `/event` slash command). Omit for dashboard creates.

client_message_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the chat card, reconciling the optimistic loading placeholder. Required alongside `channel_id`.

action_type.description: Action discriminator. `reaction:<emoji>` for emoji reactions, `vote` for poll votes (UPSERT), free-form for card actions.

channel_id.description: When set with `client_message_id`, posts an append-only points card to this chat channel after the ledger write (the `/points` slash command). Omit for dashboard adjustments.

client_message_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the chat card, reconciling the optimistic loading placeholder. Required alongside `channel_id`.

success_url.description: URL to redirect on successful payment

cancel_url.description: URL to redirect on canceled payment

return_url.description: URL to redirect when leaving the portal

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the uploaded file

proof_path.description: Storage path to proof file (e.g. from upload)

review_comment.description: Optional comment for the member (especially on rejection)

channel_id.description: When set with `client_message_id`, posts an interactive task card to this chat channel after the task is created (the `/task` slash command). Omit for dashboard creates.

client_message_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the chat card, reconciling the optimistic loading placeholder. Required alongside `channel_id`.

option_indexes.description: Option index(es) to vote for. Single choice: [0]. Multi choice: [0, 1].

url.description: Signed download URL, valid for one hour

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp at which the URL stops working

row_count.description: Number of data rows in the document

user_id.description: Filter by user ID (omit for chapter-wide)

window.description: Time window for totals (defaults to all-time). Defined identically to the points leaderboard: semester excludes the latest archive period; month is the trailing calendar month.
